# Vendored frontend assets

Served locally so the webapp works without internet access (LAN/offline use).
Update by re-downloading and replacing the files, then adjust the versions here.

| File | Upstream | Version | License |
|------|----------|---------|---------|
| pico.classless.min.css | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@picocss/pico@2/css/pico.classless.min.css | 2.1.1 | MIT (banner in file) |
| htmx.min.js | https://unpkg.com/htmx.org@2/dist/htmx.min.js | 2.0.11 | Zero-Clause BSD (https://github.com/bigskysoftware/htmx/blob/master/LICENSE) |
